overview:
Austin-based TX-37 is one of the most Democratic-leaning districts in Texas, with a partisan lean of about 30 points toward Democrats. Incumbent Greg Casar is running for reelection with a large financial advantage, having raised roughly $1.4 million and holding over $550,000 on hand. Republican challenger Lauren Peña has raised about $130,000 with minimal cash remaining and no visible outside spending on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the lopsided resource gap. Prediction markets price a Democratic win near 97%, in line with the district's strong lean. The expected margin is roughly 29 points, and the race is rated Safe Democratic.
